scripts.check:packaging-tools: rustc --version && cargo --version && python -m PyInstaller --version && npx.cmd tauri --version
scripts.build:backend: python -m PyInstaller --noconfirm --onedir --noconsole --disable-windowed-traceback --paths backend --additional-hooks-dir packaging/hooks --runtime-hook packaging/runtime_timezone.py --exclude-module scipy --exclude-module matplotlib --exclude-module IPython --exclude-module PIL --exclude-module psycopg --exclude-module psycopg2 --exclude-module pymysql --exclude-module MySQLdb --exclude-module pytest --exclude-module setuptools --exclude-module distutils --exclude-module _distutils_hack --exclude-module pyarrow.flight --exclude-module pyarrow._flight --exclude-module pyarrow.substrait --exclude-module pyarrow._substrait --exclude-module pyarrow._pyarrow_cpp_tests --add-data "backend/app/assets/plotly.min.js;app/assets" --name cellxplorer-backend packaging/backend_entry.py && python packaging/tcl_timezone_archive.py dist/cellxplorer-backend && python packaging/timezone_archive.py dist/cellxplorer-backend
scripts.tauri:build:stable: python scripts/frontend_channel.py verify --channel stable && tauri build
scripts.tauri:build:beta: python scripts/frontend_channel.py verify --channel beta && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.beta.conf.json
scripts.tauri:build:alpha: python scripts/frontend_channel.py verify --channel alpha && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.alpha.conf.json
